title: fix(service-datasource): a missing optional driver package (turso, mongodb, sqlite-wasm) is refused with the factory's install alone, not the unbuilt-workspace build advice
body:
Fixes #24937

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

A `turso`, `mongodb` or `sqlite-wasm` datasource whose optional driver package is not installed is refused at boot. The factory's own text already says so and names the install (`npm install @objectstack/driver-turso`, with the `pnpm add` and `yarn add` spellings beside it). The refusal then ended on `UNBUILT_WORKSPACE_REMEDY` anyway: "… That is a build precondition … Run `pnpm install && pnpm build`, then start again." That is two fixes that contradict each other, and the second does nothing for a project, which adds these packages itself.

`connectFailureRemedy()` chose the unbuilt remedy for every module-not-found except the three database clients PR #24933 split off (`pg`, `mysql2`, `better-sqlite3`). A bare `@objectstack/driver-*` specifier still classified as unbuilt, and four factory classifier pins asserted that.

## What changed

Seat ruling **B** on the card. The code change is in `packages/services/service-datasource/src/connect-failure-remedy.ts`, and it is a message branch only.

- New closed list `OPTIONAL_DRIVER_PACKAGES`, built from the factory's own constants (`TURSO_DRIVER_PACKAGE`, `MONGODB_DRIVER_PACKAGE`, `SQLITE_WASM_DRIVER_PACKAGE`). A pin holds it equal to the optional peers `package.json` declares (`peerDependenciesMeta.*.optional`). Measured set: exactly those three.
- `missingOptionalDriverPackage(cause)` reads the same first `Cannot find module|package 'X'` specifier PR #24933 introduced. It answers X only when X is one of those three, as a bare name.
- `connectFailureRemedy()` then ends on `missingOptionalDriverPackageRemedy(X)`. That is ONE sentence deferring to the install the factory text already names: "The fix is the install of `X` named above, then start again: it is an OPTIONAL driver package the project adds itself, so a build cannot produce it and no boot-time override can stand in for it." It names no command, no build, no environment variable and no configuration key.
- `isUnbuiltWorkspaceFailure()` answers false for that case.
- These keep their remedies:
  - A PATH into one of those packages (`…/driver-turso/dist/index.mjs`) keeps `UNBUILT_WORKSPACE_REMEDY`, and so does a subpath of one.
  - `@objectstack/driver-sql` and any other `@objectstack/…` name keep it too.
  - The three clients keep PR #24933's remedy.
  - Every other cause keeps `GENERIC_CONNECT_FAILURE_REMEDY`, byte for byte.
- The module note gains a section for this case.

Unchanged, per the hard stops:
- The factory's own messages: `default-datasource-driver-factory.ts` is not in the diff.
- When boot is refused, the error type, the retained state and the `OS_ALLOW_DRIVER_CONNECT_FAILURE` path.
- `sqlite-driver-fallback.ts`, `packages/types/**`, `packages/drivers/**` and `packages/spec/**` are not touched.
- No new env var, flag or gate.

## Premise re-check (the ruling's P), measured before any edit

P: in this monorepo, once `pnpm install` has run, a missing or unbuilt optional driver surfaces as a PATH, not as a bare `Cannot find package` name.

Setup: a fresh worktree at `8cfe1f94cb`, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, no build. All three packages are linked into `service-datasource/node_modules/@objectstack/`.

- **Resolver leg** (no build at all): Node 22, from `packages/services/service-datasource`. For each package, ESM and CJS both answer a path:
  - ESM: `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND | Cannot find module '…/service-datasource/node_modules/@objectstack/driver-turso/dist/index.mjs' imported from …`
  - CJS: `MODULE_NOT_FOUND | Cannot find module '…/driver-turso/dist/index.js'`
  - `driver-mongodb` and `driver-sqlite-wasm` answer the same shape.
- **Boot leg**: the service's closure built EXCEPT the three drivers, then a datasource bound to `my_app_note` booted per driver through the real factory and the real `DatasourceConnectionService` (built `dist/`). Every arm's first unresolved specifier is the `…/driver-X/dist/index.mjs` PATH.

P holds, so B ships. A contributor with an unbuilt checkout is still told to build. That is unchanged by this PR, and the pins for it are now path-shaped.

## Measured on the card's path, before and after

The published `@objectstack/service-datasource@18.0.0` was installed alone in an empty directory, with no driver packages (`npm install --ignore-scripts`). A declared datasource bound to one object was booted per optional driver through the published factory and `DatasourceConnectionService`, under both `dist/index.js` (ESM) and `dist/index.cjs` (CJS).

- **Before (18.0.0):**
  - the first unresolved specifier is the bare `@objectstack/driver-turso` (`-mongodb`, `-sqlite-wasm`);
  - the refusal names `npm install` once AND ends on "… Run `pnpm install && pnpm build`, then start again."
- **After:** the same directory with this branch's packed build installed over the published one (`pnpm pack` of `service-datasource`, marker grep: positive control 1 hit, the 18.0.0 copy 0 hits):
  - all three arms, ESM and CJS, end on "The fix is the install of `@objectstack/driver-X` named above, then start again: …";
  - `npm install` appears exactly once in the whole refusal;
  - `pnpm install` and `pnpm build` are absent.
- **NOT MEASURED:** the `os dev` scaffold path itself (`create-objectstack@18.0.0`, a turso datasource). Reason: the CLI reaches this refusal through the same factory and `DatasourceConnectionService` measured above. The card measured the scaffold's before-state, and a scaffold after-state needs this unpublished build overridden into a full CLI install.

## Tests (head `87b717e5a0`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource typecheck`: `tsc --noEmit`, exit 0. `--listFiles` includes both edited test files.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource test`: `Test Files 49 passed (49)`, `Tests 899 passed (899)`.
- New pins (`datasource-connection-service.test.ts`):
  - Each optional package × {ESM `Cannot find package 'X' imported from …` with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`, CJS `Cannot find module 'X'` plus `Require stack` with `MODULE_NOT_FOUND`} goes through the factory's real message builders (the turso one as `MissingDriverPackageError`). Each ends on the deferring sentence. The whole refusal holds exactly one `npm install`, no `pnpm build`, no `pnpm install`, no unbuilt remedy and no generic advice.
  - A path into each package keeps the unbuilt remedy, and so does a subpath.
  - The remedy is one sentence with no command, `OS_*` variable or `--database`.
  - The escape hatch still boots degraded.
  - The list equals the manifest's optional peers.
  - Classifier units: bare name only, module-not-found only, `@objectstack/driver-sql` is not on the list, a code-only error names nothing.
  - The existing #24933 client pins and the `ECONNREFUSED` / `28P01` generic pins are unchanged and green.
- Revised factory classifier pins (`default-datasource-driver-factory.test.ts`). The card says three; there are FOUR sites asserting `isUnbuiltWorkspaceFailure(...)` true on a bare-package cause: the turso, sqlite-wasm and mongodb "keeps the import error verbatim" cases, and the three-arm parity case.
  - Each now asserts the unbuilt reading on a PATH-shaped cause (`unbuiltCause(pkg)`, the measured shape).
  - Each asserts the bare name is that package's missing install.
  - The parity block gains one case for the bare reading.
- No real-path pin was added, because none is cheap here. vitest wraps every mock-factory throw in its own "[vitest] There was an error when mocking a module" error (`@vitest/mocker` `createHelpfulError`, measured in the installed 4.1.11). A staged absence therefore cannot carry Node's text to the classifier. The factory has no import seam, and its file is off this PR's surface. The before/after run above is the real-path evidence instead.

## Ablation (one leg per changed behaviour; fix committed first; `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, WRAP mode)

Each leg ran the three suites `datasource-connection-service`, `default-datasource-driver-factory` and `missing-driver-client-boot-refusal`. The subjects resolve through relative `src` imports, so no `dist/` leg applies.

1. **Delete the `connectFailureRemedy` branch** (`if (driverPackage !== undefined) return missingOptionalDriverPackageRemedy(driverPackage);`).
   - On disk: anchor 1 → 0, blob `e6403dd54e18` → `bf36838df528`.
   - Predicted red. Result: `Tests 6 failed | 150 passed`, exactly the six ESM/CJS deferring-remedy pins.
   - Restored by `git checkout HEAD --`: blob `e6403dd54e18` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status` clean.
2. **Drop the `isUnbuiltWorkspaceFailure` exclusion** (`&& missingOptionalDriverPackage(cause) === undefined`).
   - The first attempt was a no-op. The tool refused it on its own replacement-count check (newline replacement), restored, and never ran the suites.
   - Re-run with a distinctive replacement. On disk: anchor 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob `e6403dd54e18` → `ebf06e9d96f4`.
   - Predicted: the classifier pins go red, and the service-level remedy pins stay green because the branch runs first. Result: `Tests 5 failed | 151 passed`, exactly the five classifier pins. The four factory sites plus the unit failed; the remedy pins stayed green.
   - Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Gates (local subset, head `87b717e5a0`)

- Derivation: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 66 commands, 4 changed paths vs merge base `8cfe1f94c`.
- Each command was run once, exit captured before any pipe.
- Result: 65 exit 0, and 1 NOT MEASURED, `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. It exited 3 with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: it reads every package's `dist/`, and this worktree builds only the `service-datasource` closure. CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.
- `--ran` reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 66 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 65 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`, exit 0.
- The repo-wide scans and the CI-only families (`Test Core`, `Build Core`, the type-check lanes) are CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **The #24909 changeset goes partly false when this lands.** Its "Unchanged" bullet in `.changeset/24909-missing-driver-client-remedy.md` is still unreleased. It reads "an `@objectstack/…` driver package that is not installed, still ends on `pnpm install && pnpm build`". That stops being true for the three optional driver packages.
  - The file is outside this PR's declared surface, so it is not edited here.
  - Suggested one-word narrowing before the next release consumes it: "or a required `@objectstack/…` driver package that is not installed".
  - This PR's own changeset states the new behaviour.
- **One factory comment drifts slightly.** In `default-datasource-driver-factory.ts`, the `missingTursoDriverMessage` doc says the classifier "can only recognise an unbuilt/uninstalled workspace" from the interpolated text. With this change an uninstalled optional package is read as an install, not as unbuilt. The file is off-surface by the hard stop, and nothing else in it is made false. Carrier: none.
- **The workspace mirror is unchanged.** In this monorepo with an UNBUILT optional driver, the factory's text says "is not installed … `npm install @objectstack/driver-X`", and the refusal then correctly ends on the build advice. The boot-leg measurement above shows `npm install` and `pnpm build` both present. That is the factory message's wording, which is out of scope here by the hard stop, and ruling B accepted the workspace reading. It was measured at the service seam only, with no public door. Carrier: none.

> **Seat's append** (`domain:services` seat 1, `session_011TdZ8GjixNZFLz1xJD9zzK`): the dev's round-2 markdown from os-dev report `6300109209` on #24937, verbatim. The dev writes the body once and never PATCHes it. The seat's written confirmation of the DELIBERATE CORRECTION is in its ACCEPT on this PR.

## Round 2: the client-remedy changeset's "Unchanged" bullet (seat ruling A on open question 1)

`.changeset/24909-missing-driver-client-remedy.md` is still unreleased. Its "Unchanged" bullet said "an `@objectstack/…` driver package that is not installed, still ends on `pnpm install && pnpm build`", which this PR makes false for the three optional driver packages. That one bullet now reads:

> A driver package whose build output is missing, or a required `@objectstack/…` driver package that is not installed (any but the optional `@objectstack/driver-turso`, `@objectstack/driver-mongodb` and `@objectstack/driver-sqlite-wasm`), still ends on `pnpm install && pnpm build`.

- It is a one-line edit (`1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)`). No other line of that file changed, and no other file changed in this round.
- It matches the code. A path into any driver package's `dist/` is still the unbuilt remedy, and so is a bare `@objectstack/…` name off `OPTIONAL_DRIVER_PACKAGES` (e.g. `@objectstack/driver-sql`). A bare name on that list ends on `missingOptionalDriverPackageRemedy`.
- `origin/main` `693352e4c2` was merged first. It brings PR #24955 on `sqlite-driver-fallback.ts`, disjoint from this diff.
- Head `e759c6c8e9`:
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource typecheck`: exit 0.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource test`: `Test Files 50 passed (50)`, `Tests 908 passed (908)`. That includes #24955's new file.
- Gates: re-derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`. That gives 5 paths vs merge base `693352e4c` and 66 commands, the same set as round 1 (the new path adds no family). All 66 were re-run at this head under the lock, `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main` among them. Results: 64 exit 0; 1 NOT MEASURED, `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, it reads every package's `dist/`); and 1 red BY DESIGN, `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main` (exit 1). `--ran` reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 66 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 65 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`, exit 0.

### `Check Changeset` stays red, and that is the gate's DELIBERATE CORRECTION class

`check-empty-changeset` refuses any PR that changes a changeset it did not add. Here that is `.changeset/24909-missing-driver-client-remedy.md`, `M` against merge base `693352e4c`, beside this PR's own `A` `.changeset/24937-optional-driver-package-remedy.md`. The gate names two classes with opposite remedies. This is the second one, not a filename collision: this PR's own code change made that PENDING release note false, and this round rewrites only the sentence it falsified. Per the gate's own remedy text, which `pr-automation.yml`'s route 0 repeats for the same class:

- The note is NOT restored from the base. That would republish the false sentence.
- `skip-changeset` is NOT applied. Ruled on #18375 (ruling D): never on a PR that edits an existing changeset.
- The check is left red. `Check Changeset` is not one of the five required contexts, so it blocks no merge.

The note is `.changeset/24909-missing-driver-client-remedy.md`. What changed under it: this PR routes a bare `@objectstack/driver-turso` / `-mongodb` / `-sqlite-wasm` module-not-found to the factory's install instead of the build advice. Only its "Unchanged" bullet's second clause is narrowed to match. The correction was ruled by the `domain:services` seat 1 PM (ruling A on open question 1 of the os-dev report on #24937). The seat records that confirmation on this PR in writing.
